subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: Should inbound WhatsApp call activity be agent-visible, and what minimal fields and retention scope are permitted?
rationale: Baileys supplies the transport event, but current OpenClaw contracts do not decide whether sensitive call activity should be emitted, stored, or queryable.

options.title: Ephemeral sanitized event
options.body: Emit an opt-in, access-filtered activity event with minimal fields and no persistent call history.

options.title: Persistent contact history
options.body: Define storage schema, retention, user controls, and migration behavior before recording normalized call activity.

options.title: Defer call ingestion
options.body: Wait for a general contact-activity product model before consuming Baileys call events.

recommendation.title: Ephemeral sanitized event
recommendation.body: Emit an opt-in, access-filtered activity event with minimal fields and no persistent call history.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest product and implementation history for WhatsApp call and privacy boundaries is tied to this owner candidate.
